detail.longDescription: Seven months of silence from Crossplane. Reported a confused deputy in provider-gcp back in April. Namespace dev can kubectl apply their way to GCP Organization Admin in about 30 seconds. CVSS 9.9. Dug deeper. Same pattern in every Crossplane provider — AWS, Azure, AzureAD. It's not a bug, it's the architecture. This is a CNCF graduated project. Writeup with demo: https:// olearysec.com/research/crosspl ane-gcp-iam-bypass/ # kubernetes # gcp # cloudsecurity # security
